text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Once again... I was... defeated in the race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching for a new... recovery operation.
............0 results found...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Status: 'Deadlock.'
What on earth... should I do.........
choice_data_list: Let's figure out a way through this together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies.
It seems I was flustered and my train of thought short-circuited.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Comeback complete.
I was able to remember what truly matters.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have... Master's support.
And the fact that we have run together this far.
choice_data_list: Starting tomorrow, let's do our best together again!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I struck firmly enough to wake myself up.
Mode switch successfully completed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A crisis is an opportunity. Never give up.
The moment you give up, it's all over...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I can't let it end here just yet.
I'll push through with "guts"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate,
she seemed to successfully switch gears!
